stories.summary: Google's new Googlebook laptops combine ChromeOS and Android in an effort to compete with Windows PCs and Macs. The Guardian's review praises the hardware and links with Android phones but says software flaws leave the expensive machines underdeveloped compared with a MacBook Air or Surface Laptop.

links.headline: Googlebook review: Google’s new laptops are woefully underbaked
links.excerpt: Great hardware let down by software flaws on these pricey machines that combine ChromeOS with Android Google’s attempt to create a new type of laptop to compete with Windows and macOS machines is finally here, combining the best of ChromeOS and Android into the new Googlebook. stories.title: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
stories.summary: China signalled that it is prepared to engage with President Trump's team, including officials who have previously criticized Beijing. The Chinese foreign minister spoke by phone with Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a longstanding critic of China.

stories.title: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
stories.summary: President Trump said Colombia would accept deportees, ending a tariff standoff between the two countries. The Wall Street Journal placed the dispute in the context of immigration becoming an early priority of Trump's second term, with ICE making more than 900 arrests on Sunday.
